_compatNote: Chromium runs background/index.js as an MV3 service worker (no DOM; suspends when idle, so the click-to-monitor state is memory-only and indefinite). scripting.executeScript/insertCSS inject content/modal.js + content/modal.css on the clicked tab under the activeTab grant. No offscreen document: offscreen is Chromium-only and unnecessary for an in-tab modal.
